_doc: NB2-at-NB1-slot cross-class test config. All 8 NB1 slots are filled with NB2-class boss modifiers from the untested-under-rando set. This tests two things: (a) whether the engine validates modifier-class against slot (if it does, some/all of these will fail to spawn), and (b) whether each of these arenas works under rando. NB2 slots use known-good bosses as ballast, with Morgott serving as the 9th data point (currently only OK_vanilla, no rando test).

_arenas_under_test.Gladius_NB1: m48_30 Dancer of the Boreal Valley (was WAVE_BLOCKED)
_arenas_under_test.Gnoster_NB1: m48_80 Godskin Duo Noble + Apostle (was OK_spawn)
_arenas_under_test.Heolstor_NB2: m48_40 Morgott (currently OK_vanilla, untested under rando)
